description: This file contains a test class EmployeeTimeAtWorkDaoTest for testing the EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao class's methods related to employee attendance records in a Human Resource Management system. It uses PHPUnit for unit testing and sets up fixture data for testing database interactions.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionality of EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao methods related to employee attendance records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the latest attendance record for employees by employee number, including cases with no records.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Tests retrieval of attendance records for an employee within a date range, including multiple records across days.
